_caps: A grant never exceeds its table's cap (no day cap since 2026-09-23 — 体力 alone limits a day).
_economy: 2026-09-24, redesign-v2 (the daily boards, 历练, 伤势 and the elite's own pay cut; 问卦 no longer multiplies 修为). A normal 练气 day in 徐 BEFORE: three fights (~2.5 won, one an elite at 38) ≈ 64, the six hosted games 30, story and errands ≈ 20, today's rumor (4 steps at 10 + a finale at 25) 65 — ≈ 179. With the cuts and the old numbers it would be 62 + 0 + 20 + 65 ≈ 147 (−18%). AFTER, with a fight at 30 and the rumor at 15 a step, 30 its finale, 90 its cap: fights 2.5 × 30 = 75, story and errands ≈ 20, the rumor 3 × 15 + 30 = 75 — ≈ 170 (−5%), so 练气's 810 still takes about five days of play. 修为 per 体力 at 练气: a fight 30/8 = 3.75 (3.2 at the gate's ~85% win) — still the best; a rumor's step 15 for a game's 3 and the walk (~6) ≈ 2.5. A hosted game pays only the errand that asked for it (a notice's 40), for 3 体力. 开府 (a setup milestone, paid once ever, table `once`) 40 修为 + 20 灵石.
_tale: 今日传闻 (design.md § 今日传闻): Ling writes no number. Each step pays the `tale` table and the finale the `tale_end` table, both capped; the whole tale never pays more than `cap` (a fifth step eats into the finale), and pay() scales it by the roots and the realm like any grant. One finale `drop`: the highest-tier entry at or below the player's realm (an item, or a card not held and of a root the player has), picked by the tale's id — and the finale also leaves a 符 and raises the 本命法宝 one 重 (`growth`). Raised 2026-09-24 (redesign-v2: the rumor is the day's main dish, the daily boards are gone): 15 a step, 30 the finale, 90 the cap — see `_economy`.
_stamina: stamina is the pace — design.md § 灵气. Refills by the clock, full in refill_hours; actions cost it; a quest paid refills it (the app's own `qi`, else refill.quest).

bond._about: 银月 beside the player (redesign-v2 § 四: no relationship score). What walking together gives her card comes from the story alone: the chapters ended. 相知/相惜/同心 are no longer counted or shown; the lifts are the ones the gate measured (2026-09-23): +1/+1 at most — +2/+2 won 97%, which is not a fight.

_growth: 本命法宝 and 符 grow from the story, never from a daily tap (redesign-v2 § 四: 温养 · 强化 · 写符 cut). The treasure rises one 重 each time a chapter ends and each time 今日传闻's finale is won, up to 九重. A rumor's finale leaves one 符; a fight won leaves one on one win in `fight_one_in` (by the day, the beast and the 道号).
